text_en: We've been through a lot, but it looks like everyone trusts the information you found on your last adventure.
Once Brigard gives the order, we'll leave for the Guardian.
I wonder if he's as powerful as the legend suggests...
What... excited? You bet I am! I can't wait to see what he looks like.
I hope I'm allowed to take a few things from here. There's still books I'd like to read.
